summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Smart Logistics Global Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting its fiscal year 2025 financial results. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details a 7.3% revenue decline to RMB628.5 million, a net loss of RMB18.2 million versus net income of RMB8.7 million in 2024, and improved gross margin to 4.7%. The filing also mentions a new supply chain center in Xuzhou. There is no transaction, event, or catalyst that qualifies as a special situation; this is a routine earnings report. No deal terms are present.
